title: The Poster That Spoke Too Loudly
learning_focus: Hyperbole and irony; adjectival phrases; non-verbal cues; visual purpose; creation of a visual text; cultural appropriateness.
story_premise: A promotional poster uses wild exaggeration and an ironic slogan that visitors misunderstand. The Pathfinder works with performers and designers to repair the message.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Hyperbole and irony; adjectival phrases; non-verbal cues; visual purpose; creation of a visual text; cultural appropriateness.
